GenOpPlanRequest.name: GenOpPlanRequest
GenOpPlanRequest.description: Represents a request to generate a service plan. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

CopilotId.description: (Optional) The ID of the Einstein Copilot associated with the plan request.

CopilotName.description: (Optional) The name of the Einstein Copilot associated with the plan request.

ErrorCode.description: (Optional) The standard error code when plan generation fails.

ErrorMessage.description: (Optional) The error message when plan generation fails.

LlmModelName.description: (Optional) The name of the large language model used for plan generation. The maximum length is 80 characters.

LlmProviderName.description: (Optional) The name of the LLM provider. The maximum length is 80 characters.

Name.description: (Required) The auto-generated name of the generated operation plan request.

ParentId.description: (Required) The ID of the service plan parent record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PromptTemplateDevName.description: (Optional) The developer name of the prompt template used for plan generation. The maximum length is 80 characters.

PromptTemplateVersionNo.description: (Optional) The version number of the prompt template.

Reason.description: (Required) The reason why plan generation failed or returned no steps. Possible values are: CannotGeneratePlan NoEligibilityConfig (no eligibility criteria set) None (default) NoPlanGenerated PlanEmpty PlanEmptyInsufficientData RagConfigurationError ThresholdError (eligibility not met for unknown reason) ThresholdNotMet

RequestSource.description: (Optional) The source where the plan request originated. Possible values are: CASE EINSTEIN_LEX (Einstein Chat LEX component) INCIDENT

RequestType.description: (Required) The type of service plan request. Possible values are: Close Generation Summary (default)

Status.description: (Required) The status of the plan generation request. Possible values are: Error Incomplete InProgress (default) Success

Utterance.description: (Optional) The natural language input or prompt used for plan generation. The maximum length is 32,000 characters.

GenOpPlanRequest.accessRules: To access this object, you must have the Service Planner Access add-on license.
